notes.title: Big update before launch!
notes.notes:
It's only a few days to the release, and Live Art has just got a lot better. Here's a detailed list of what's got added:

[list]
[*] [b]Music:[/b] many relaxing tracks to help you with the mood while trying to beat the levels. It also comes with a cool effect when you lost.
[*] [b]Leaderboard:[/b] a separate leaderboard for each and every level. You now can see how you compete with your friends and the world.
[*][b]Achievements[/b]: you now are rewarded with achievements for your effort!
[*][b]Controller and keyboard support[/b]: you now can draw and restart a level with your keyboard or a game controller. This will make Steamdeck users enjoy the game much better.
[/list]

And there are many improvements in user experiences.

Let's wishlist Live Art now!
